title: Put the Lord’s House First
old_p1: Haggai was a prophet, a man who speaks for Heavenly Father. The people had come home to Jerusalem from far away.
The Lord’s house, the temple, was not finished. A temple is a holy house, very special to Heavenly Father. Yet the people built fine houses for themselves.
The Lord said, “Consider your ways.” That means, stop and think about what you are doing.
old_p2: The Lord said, “Go up to the mountain, bring wood, and build the house.” The people listened. The Lord said, “I am with you.” Then everyone went to work!
You can put the Lord first too. Tonight, think of one way to put Him first tomorrow. Then snuggle down and smile.
p1: The people had come home to Jerusalem from far away. They built nice houses for themselves. But the Lord’s house was still not built.
“It is not time yet,” they said. So Heavenly Father sent Haggai. “Is it time for nice houses,” the Lord asked, “while My house lies broken?”
The people worked hard, but they never had enough. “Consider your ways,” said the Lord. Stop and think: what should come first?
p2: “Go up to the mountain, bring wood, and build the house,” said the Lord. The people obeyed. “I am with you,” the Lord said through Haggai. Everyone went to work!
You can put Heavenly Father first too, like praying before you play. Tonight, think of one way to put Him first tomorrow.
